Blackboard was founded on one conviction: technology should make teaching and learning better. We’ve
built our platform on that principle, and today, we’re embracing another: AI will again improve
teaching and learning. We’re not adding features to check boxes. We’re building the environment
where exceptional teaching happens and where every learner gets the experience they deserve.

## Blackboard in motion

[Explore More][19]

Our New Brand

The Evolution of Blackboard

Blackboard has always been about one thing: helping educators do what they do best. Since 1997, that
has meant building the infrastructure that makes teaching and learning possible, online and in
person, at scale. Today, we are sharing what that evolution looks like next.

[Learn More][20]

Why This Webinar, Why Now

Protecting Your Institution and Students: Privacy, Security & Compliance in Higher Ed

The landscape has shifted. States are passing AI legislation. Data sovereignty debates are
intensifying. Cyber threats to educational institutions are top of mind. Your students, faculty, and
community expect their data to be protected no matter what.

[Learn More][21]

A conversation with Jo Packer, VP of Design

Usability starts with U: How your feedback directly informs Blackboard LMS development

Usability in learning technology is often presented with a wide range of synonymous terms, acronyms,
and metrics. With so many different measures and expressions of data, it can be difficult to cut
through the noise and identify what really matters for users’ daily learning experience.

[Learn More][22]

FAQ

## Questions, answered.

What does Blackboard do?

Blackboard is an education technology company. It builds Blackboard LMS and connected products for
accessibility (Ally), course evaluation (Evaluate), and institutional effectiveness — the digital
environment for transformational teaching and learning.

What products does Blackboard offer?

Blackboard LMS is the core platform, with add-ons including AVA, Video Studio, Adopt, Milestone, and
Catalog. This is complemented by Blackboard Ally for accessibility, Blackboard Evaluate for course
feedback, Blackboard Illuminate for analytics, and the Institutional Effectiveness suite for
accreditation, planning, and program review.

Who uses Blackboard?

Institutions across higher education, government, workforce and corporate learning, and K-12.
Millions of learners of all ages and backgrounds use Blackboard to pursue their learning and career
goals, from first-year undergraduates to continuing education, agency training programs, and
professional development.

What is Blackboard LMS?

Blackboard LMS is Blackboard’s AI-powered learning management system, rebuilt around the learner
rather than the course. Explore what it does differently on the Blackboard LMS page.

See what’s possible.

FAQ

## Questions, answered.

What does Blackboard do?

Blackboard is an education technology company. It builds Blackboard LMS and connected products for
accessibility (Ally), course evaluation (Evaluate), and institutional effectiveness — the digital
environment for transformational teaching and learning.

What products does Blackboard offer?

Blackboard LMS is the core platform, with add-ons including AVA, Video Studio, Adopt, Milestone, and
Catalog. This is complemented by Blackboard Ally for accessibility, Blackboard Evaluate for course
feedback, Blackboard Illuminate for analytics, and the Institutional Effectiveness suite for
accreditation, planning, and program review.

Who uses Blackboard?

Institutions across higher education, government, workforce and corporate learning, and K-12.
Millions of learners of all ages and backgrounds use Blackboard to pursue their learning and career
goals, from first-year undergraduates to continuing education, agency training programs, and
professional development.

What is Blackboard LMS?

rather than the course. Explore what it does differently on the Blackboard LMS page.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

## INTRODUCTION

Government Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) in Chhattisgarh play a vital role in equipping
youth with industry-relevant technical skills. Established and managed by the Department of Skill
Development, Technical Education and Employment, these institutes aim to provide vocational
education and hands-on training to enhance employment opportunities for students, especially from
rural and underprivileged backgrounds.

After the formation of the state in the year 2000, Chhattisgarh prioritized skill development as a
key driver for socio-economic growth. Today, over 100 government ITIs are operational across the
state, including in remote and tribal areas, ensuring widespread access to technical education.

### Cisco Cloud Control

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

[Discover Cisco Cloud Control][29]
[AI Canvas London Network Troubleshooting results]

### Enterprise operations at agentic AI speed

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute
complex workflows at machine speed—while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

[Discover AI Canvas][30]
[AI networking]

### Resilient, high-speed AI networking

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]
[Cisco Silicon One processor on a circuit board in shades of blue and grey]

### Silicon to power AI-scale networking

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

### Distributed, optimized enforcement

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]
[Cisco IQ Assets Overview dashboard featuring a total assets count, coverage percentage, and AI
Assistant messages]

### Cisco IQ

Cisco IQ is the unified AI-powered experience that delivers real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]
[glow background]

Modernize and transform your data centers to power traditional and AI workloads anywhere—with speed,
scale, and flexibility.

About Company

## Who We Are

[ Learn more ][51]

PT Computrade Technology International (CTI Group) is the biggest IT distributor company in
Southeast Asia with progressive innovation since 2003.

We proudly expand our territory across Southeast Asia by establishing:

## About CTI Group

[ic 1]
12 IT Companies

We currently oversee 12 IT COMPANIES specializing in technologies expertise based on product and
service differentiation.

13
[technology]
100+ World Leading IT Brands

We have strong partnerships with more than 100 World-Leading IT Brands.

70+
[badge]
250+ Certified Engineers

More than 250 International Certified Engineer to give you the best support & experience in
discovering your digital needs.

250+

CTI Awards & Recognitions

## 160 Awards since 2003

AWS Consulting Partner of the Year 2026
APAC Breakthrough Distributor Award - Oracle Partner Awards 2025
⁠PaloAlto ASEAN Distributor Excellence Award 2025
NetApp FY25 GCASK Growth Distributor of The Year Award - FSI
HPE FY24 Services Distributor of The Year
Best Grab for Business Channel Partner 2024
Dell Technologies Best Storage Distributor Award 2024
F5 Indonesia Distributor of The Year 2024

CTI Group proudly presents DIGIForward, our CSR initiative focused on equipping vocational (SMK)
educators and students with essential cloud technology skills.

We believe vocational schools play a strategic role in preparing Indonesia’s future workforce with
industry-relevant skills.
Yet many educators face a technological gap in digital literacy.
Our first step begins in East Java, home to the second-highest number of SMKs in Indonesia.

[career img]

## #lifeatCTI

**Join us and be a part of the CTI Group family.**

Seize opportunities and shine your way through to achieve goals in a home where you can learn and
grow.

Together, embrace the digital world with countless innovations and breakthroughs to provide the
greatest service to our customers and partners.

# Residential English Camp in Thailand

Residential English Camp in Hua Hin, Thailand with Dragon Study Tours takes place at The Palm
Residence, where students live and learn in a fully supervised environment with on-site classrooms.
* Direct international flights to Bangkok make access simple
* Short, safe transfer to Hua Hin’s calm seaside setting
* Modern, all-under-one-roof residence ideal for young learners
* A new destination that’s safe, charming, and perfect for study abroad

Our Residential English Camp offers closed-group safety, structured lessons, and cultural
experiences — everything students need for a complete learning journey.

[ Get A Quote ][81]
[Happy students making a heart symbol with hands during Residential English Camp Experience in Hua
Hin, part of the Academic Programme with Dragon Study Tours][Happy students making a heart symbol
with hands during Residential English Camp Experience in Hua Hin, part of the Academic Programme
with Dragon Study Tours]

## Student Residence in Hua Hin – Safe, Modern & All-in-One

The Student Residence in Hua Hin is the dedicated home for Dragon Study Tours students — a secure,
fully supervised accommodation for young learners. It offers a safe and supportive environment where
student welfare always comes first.

• 24/7 security, night manager, and residence team ensuring supervision
• Triple, quadruple, and quintuple air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms
• Healthy meals served daily in a monitored dining area
• On-site classrooms for a complete all-under-one-roof experience

The Student Residence in Hua Hin is modern, comfortable, and student-focused — combining safety,
structure, and care so every student can live, learn, and thrive.


[ Get A Quote ][82]
[Smiling international students enjoying their stay at The Student Residence during the Residential
English Camp in Hua Hin, Thailand, organised by Dragon Study Tours in Hua Hin, Thailand][Smiling
international students enjoying their stay at The Student Residence during the Residential English
Camp in Hua Hin, Thailand, organised by Dragon Study Tours in Hua Hin, Thailand]

## English Study Tour in Thailand – Year-Round Learning

English Study Tour in Thailand programmes run all year, giving closed groups the chance to combine
structured English lessons with cultural adventure in Hua Hin. Designed for school groups and
educational partners, our tours deliver expert teaching, meaningful travel, and full support from
arrival to departure.

• Morning classes focus on real-world English communication.
• Afternoon excursions explore Thai culture and nature.
• Flexible options for summer, winter, and Easter holidays.
• Safe, fully organised experiences guided by our Dragon Study Tours team.

## IELTS Preparation at a British Council Exam Centre

IELTS Preparation at a British Council exam centre with Dragon Study Tours offers affordable,
high-quality English training with internationally recognised qualifications. Students study in Hua
Hin, combining expert tuition and a supportive environment that builds confidence and results.

• Prepare for IELTS Academic or General Training exams
• Learn from experienced instructors with proven success
• Study in a safe, coastal setting ideal for focused learning
• Enjoy all-inclusive packages with lessons, accommodation, meals, and activities

IELTS Preparation at a British Council exam centre delivers affordable education, cultural
immersion, and real progress.

Exam Centre in Thailand with Dragon Study Tours.]

## Dragon Study Tours App

Dragon Study Tours App 2026 ensures trusted student safety, real-time supervision, and seamless
communication for every group. Designed for schools, parents, and leaders, it provides instant
updates and peace of mind throughout each study tour in Thailand.

• Monitor attendance and location safely
• Receive real-time notifications and alerts
• Communicate easily with leaders and staff
• Access secure group information anytime

The Dragon Study Tours App 2026 combines safety, technology, and care—empowering every student
journey with trust, transparency, and confidence.

## Learn English in Hua Hin – Safe Study Travel in Thailand

Learn English in Hua Hin with Dragon Study Tours — a secure, welcoming coastal destination where
students progress fast. Our supervised programmes balance classroom learning with cultural
experiences and year-round safety.

• Safe, fully supervised schedules for all age groups
• Beautiful beaches, clean air, and a calm environment
• Friendly local community welcoming international students
• Educational excursions that combine fun and learning

Choose to learn English in Hua Hin for trusted safety, value, and memorable progress on every study
tour.

[Learn English in Hua Hin – a safe and welcoming coastal city in Thailand, home to beautiful
beaches, cultural landmarks, and trusted study-travel programmes.][Learn English in Hua Hin – a safe
and welcoming coastal city in Thailand, home to beautiful beaches, cultural landmarks, and trusted
study-travel programmes.]

## Thai Cultural Programme in Hua Hin

Thai Cultural Programme with Dragon Study Tours in Hua Hin combines English learning with authentic
Thai experiences. Students explore Thailand’s heritage through language, art, and community
interaction in a safe and welcoming environment.

• Hands-on workshops in Thai cooking, crafts, and traditions
• Visits to temples, markets, and cultural landmarks
• Daily English lessons linked to Thai life and customs
• Guidance from local instructors and cultural experts

Join our Thai Cultural Programme in Hua Hin and experience the perfect blend of learning, language,
and local culture.

experience local heritage through language and culture.][Traditional Thai dancers performing during
the Thai Cultural Programme in Hua Hin — where students experience local heritage through language
and culture.]

## Experience Hua Hin – Thailand’s Award-Winning Destination

Hua Hin is Thailand’s hidden gem — a vibrant, safe, and inspiring coastal town recently recognised
with the [ASEAN Sustainable City Award for Clean Air][88]. This regional award celebrates cities
across Southeast Asia that demonstrate exceptional commitment to environmental sustainability and
air quality improvement. Hua Hin’s achievement highlights its clean, healthy, and well-managed
environment — an ideal setting for young learners to study, explore, and thrive. Take a look at [50
Things][89] to do in Hua Hin

and adventure.**

## Thailand’s Only All-in-One English Centre & Residence

Dragon Study Tours runs the only programme in Thailand where students can live and learn in the same
place — a true Residential English Camp experience. Our on-site facility, [The Palm Residence][90],
in Hua Hin removes the need for commuting and keeps every aspect of the programme safe, structured,
and fully supported.
* Study and stay together in modern accommodation designed for groups.
* Morning English lessons with expert teachers, giving students the freedom to choose the type of
  English they want to study — from academic exam prep to practical communication skills.
* Afternoon excursions and activities that connect language learning with Thailand’s culture and
  history.

 

## Safeguarding at Our Residential English Camp

At Dragon Study Tours, safeguarding is our top priority. Following the standards set out in the[
British Council Accreditation Handbook,][91] we ensure every under-18 is fully protected throughout
their stay.

Our commitment to safeguarding:
* **24/7 supervision** – Trained staff present in classrooms, accommodation, and activities.
* **Clear policies** – Procedures aligned with international best practice.
* **Safe accommodation** – Secure rooms, monitored access, and on-site welfare staff.
* **Comprehensive risk assessments** – Every excursion and activity reviewed for safety.

Safeguarding is built into every part of our English Language Camp in Thailand, ensuring students
can learn, live, and explore with complete peace of mind.

English Language Camp in Thailand]

Dragon Study Tours offers a safe, affordable, and fully residential English camp in Hua Hin.
Students study, stay, and explore together in a structured environment designed for maximum safety,
value, and impact.

# FRANKA RESEARCH 3

Franka Research 3 is the reference world-class, force-sensitive robot system tailored for robotics
and AI. It empowers researchers with easy-to-use robot features as well as with low-level access to
robot’s control and learning capabilities.

[ Discover ][37]
[ Buy now ][38]

Franka Research 3 is the reference world-class, force-sensitive robot system tailored for robotics
and AI. It empowers researchers with easy-to-use robot features as well as with low-level access to
robot’s control and learning capabilities.

[ Discover ][39]
[ Buy now ][40]
ABOUT FRANKA
[_Frank Robotics0615_resized-1]

## EMPOWERING INNOVATORS,
## ENABLING BREAKTHROUGHS

Franka Robotics is a German, research-driven robotics company headquartered in Munich and operating
globally. Founded in 2016, it is part of Agile Robots since 2023.


Our mission is to enable the growing community of robotics and AI professionals to shape a pivotal
moment in human evolution: giving AI a robot body. We achieve this by developing the reference
robotics platform that facilitates big-thinkers to explore, collaborate, create and share – thereby
driving continuous advancements in robotics and AI.


Franka Robotics’ endeavor is contributing to a bright future where capable AI-powered robots coexist
and work alongside us, enhancing everyone’s lives and progressing society.

[ Find out more ][41]
UPCOMING PRODUCTS
[251105_MFR3_Duo_Camera01_01_fp]

## THE REFERENCE PLATFORM FOR PHYSICAL AI

A new generation of robot systems designed to enable physical intelligence research, from tactile
teleoperation to mobile manipulation. These systems enable physical AI activities, including data
collection at scale and real-world learning.
[ Discover what's new ][42]
ANNOUNCEMENT
[Diana 7 powered by FCI]

## FRANKA ROBOTICS INTEGRATES DIANA 7 BY AGILE ROBOTS

Franka Robotics has announced that the robot Diana 7 by Agile Robots now supports the Franka Control
Interface (FCI). This development paves the way for its application in research and academia. As a
result, Franka Robotics has now added Diana 7 to its ecosystem, expanding its portfolio with a robot
featuring greater reach and payload capacity.
[ Discover Diana 7 ][43]
FROM THE FRANKA COMMUNITY

## COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS

A selection of highlights from the Franka Community, from groundbreaking research in robotics and AI
to practical applications and educational resources.
1. META
   Advancing robotics and touch perception
2. TOYOTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE
   Teaching robots new behaviours
3. MIT
   Provably safe and efficient motion planning with uncertain human dynamics
4. TSINGHUA UNIVERSITY
   Learning pregrasp manipulation of objects from ungraspable poses
5. DROID
   A large-scale in-the-wild robot manipulation dataset
6. QUT
   Reactive base control for on-the-move mobile manipulation in dynamic environments
7. UNIVERSITY OF TORONTO
   ORGANA: A robotic assistant for mautomated chemistry experimentation and characterization
8. TU DRESDEN
   Robot-assisted surgery / human-machine interaction in the OR

## EMPOWERING INNOVATORS,
## ENABLING BREAKTHROUGHS

Franka Robotics is a German, research-driven robotics company headquartered in Munich and operating
globally. Founded in 2016, it is part of Agile Robots since 2023.


Our mission is to enable the growing community of robotics and AI professionals to shape a pivotal
moment in human evolution: giving AI a robot body. We achieve this by developing the reference
robotics platform that facilitates big-thinkers to explore, collaborate, create and share – thereby
driving continuous advancements in robotics and AI.


Franka Robotics’ endeavor is contributing to a bright future where capable AI-powered robots coexist
and work alongside us, enhancing everyone’s lives and progressing society.

[ Find out more ][41]
UPCOMING PRODUCTS
[251105_MFR3_Duo_Camera01_01_fp]

## THE REFERENCE PLATFORM FOR PHYSICAL AI

A new generation of robot systems designed to enable physical intelligence research, from tactile
teleoperation to mobile manipulation. These systems enable physical AI activities, including data
collection at scale and real-world learning.
[ Discover what's new ][42]
ANNOUNCEMENT
[Diana 7 powered by FCI]

## FRANKA ROBOTICS INTEGRATES DIANA 7 BY AGILE ROBOTS

Franka Robotics has announced that the robot Diana 7 by Agile Robots now supports the Franka Control
Interface (FCI). This development paves the way for its application in research and academia. As a
result, Franka Robotics has now added Diana 7 to its ecosystem, expanding its portfolio with a robot
featuring greater reach and payload capacity.
[ Discover Diana 7 ][43]
FROM THE FRANKA COMMUNITY

## COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS

A selection of highlights from the Franka Community, from groundbreaking research in robotics and AI
to practical applications and educational resources.
1. META
   Advancing robotics and touch perception
2. TOYOTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE
   Teaching robots new behaviours
3. MIT
   Provably safe and efficient motion planning with uncertain human dynamics
4. TSINGHUA UNIVERSITY
   Learning pregrasp manipulation of objects from ungraspable poses
5. DROID
   A large-scale in-the-wild robot manipulation dataset
6. QUT
   Reactive base control for on-the-move mobile manipulation in dynamic environments
7. UNIVERSITY OF TORONTO
   ORGANA: A robotic assistant for mautomated chemistry experimentation and characterization
8. TU DRESDEN
   Robot-assisted surgery / human-machine interaction in the OR

8th February 2025, hybrid on Venue Ames Hotel, Melaka, Malaysia.

     resource management.

   * Creating green jobs that align with maqasid al-shariah (objectives of Islamic law) to promote
     social equity.
   * Promoting zakat and waqf (Islamic endowment) to finance sustainable development projects in
     underserved communities.

   * Strengthening partnerships with Islamic financial institutions to fund green infrastructure.
**

**

   * Digital Education and Technology in Advancing Environmental Awareness
   * Transforming Traditional Education to Align with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)

   * Embedding Islamic values of stewardship (khalifah) and accountability (amanah) into educational
     curricula.

     and technology.

   * Training programs that highlight the role of religious leaders in advocating for climate

operations, optimize resources, and ultimately support student success by making high-quality
educational content more accessible and affordable.

We provide K-12 schools and districts with a comprehensive, hassle-free solution for acquiring
printed and digital educational content. By handling quotes for every request and managing all
publisher interactions, we eliminate complexity and reduce administrative burden. Our value-added
services, including customized packing, barcoding, and book bundling, help schools efficiently
distribute materials and maximize their budgets. As a true one-stop shop, we ensure that schools

needs.

academic curricula, encourage literacy, and nurture a lifelong passion for reading.

personalized assistance, ensuring you receive the right books and resources that align with your

and other market segments in optimizing their book orders, maximizing their budgets, and

# Cómo Liberar tu celular

## Más de 3 millones de Desbloqueos de Red desde 2004

En **Movical.Net** ofrecemos soluciones online para desbloquear, resetear y chequear celulares de
las principales marcas como iPhone, Samsung, Motorola, Xiaomi, Huawei, Honor, Google Pixel, Oneplus,
Oppo, etc..

Desbloquear
[unlock phone]

## [Desbloqueo SIM][42]

Algunos operadores bloquean los celulares para que no se puedan usar otras compañías, con el
**desbloqueo de red**, se podrá liberar la red y utilizar cualquier operador.

[IMEI check phone]

## [Chequear IMEI gratis][43]

Ofrecemos un servicio totalmente gratuito para **Chequear Blacklist** y verificar si el IMEI se
encuentra reportado por pérdida, robo o impago de facturas.

[IMEI blacklister]

## [Limpiar IMEI y Quitar reporte][44]

Si tu celular tiene el IMEI reportado en lista negra y no permite hacer llamadas, te indicamos si es
posible hacer la **limpieza del IMEI** y así recuperar la señal eliminando el reporte de blacklist.

[IMEI blacklister]

## [Reportar IMEI a lista negra][45]

Servicio para añadir el IMEI de un celular robado o perdido a lista negra. Al incluir el número IMEI
a **blacklist**, el teléfono no podrá realizar ni recibir llamadas.

[reset a phone]

## [Resetear celular][46]

Encontrará tutoriales gratuitos para restablecer a los valores de fábrica cualquier teléfono.
También tenemos servicio para **eliminar y remover** la cuenta Google, iCloud, Xiaomi, etc..

[repair phone]

## [Reparar y Cambiar IMEI][47]

Ofrecemos diferentes servicios de **reparación de celulares** por software de forma remota. Podemos
reparar el firmware del equipo e incluso cambiar el IMEI dañado.

### Descubre las ventajas de cómo desbloquear la red de tu celular

**Ahorra dinero:** - Decide que compañía quieres sin restricciones, serás libre para escoger el
proveedor de servicios que quieras. Desbloqueo SIM de las principales operadoras de Estados Unidos,
como AT&T, Boost, Cricket, Dish, MetroPCS, T-Mobile, Spectrum, Tracfone, Verizon, Xfinity.. y del
resto de países como Telcel, Movistar, Claro, Tigo, Altice, Bell, etc..

**Vende tu celular más caro:** - Si te has decidido a cambiar de teléfono y quieres deshacerte de tu
viejo equipo, una decisión inteligente es venderlo liberado para poder utilizar cualquier tarjeta
SIM. Al tener la red desbloqueada, encontrarás compradores mucho más rápido y podrás pedir más
dinero por tu teléfono.

**Desbloqueo de red al instante y desde casa:** - No tienes que perder el tiempo llevando el
teléfono a ninguna tienda, el proceso es online, con un simple código o autorización de desbloqueo a
través del número IMEI, podrás desbloquear tu celular.

**Desbloqueo oficial sin perder la garantía:** - Utilizamos los mismos servidores que los
proveedores de servicios para el desbloqueo de red de la SIM, esto implica que la garantía se
conserva y todo sigue exactamente igual en tu equipo, simplemente aceptará cualquier tarjeta SIM o
eSIM.

**Permanente y 100% legal:** - Todos los teléfonos vienen preparados para ser liberados, nuestros
servidores ofrecen el mismo desbloqueo oficial que las operadoras, no existe ninguna diferencia, la
liberación de la red es para siempre y totalmente legal.

### ¿Cómo liberar un celular por IMEI?

A través del IMEI se puede desbloquear un teléfono de forma remota sin moverse de casa, sin tener
que llevarlo a ninguna tienda físicamente. El proceso se realiza marcando un código de desbloqueo
SIM o por autorización de desbloqueo en el cual el equipo se conecta a internet y se desbloquea
automáticamente.

Simplemente seleccione el modelo en nuestra web y el operador original que bloquea el teléfono. La
web le mostrará las opciones de desbloqueo para poder utilizar su equipo con cualquier operador del
mundo.


### ¿Qué es significa liberar la red un teléfono?

Liberación o desbloqueo de la red es el proceso para que un celular pueda utilizar cualquier tarjeta
SIM o eSIM, es decir, se pueda usar cualquier compañía del mundo.


### ¿Cuánto cuesta un desbloquear un teléfono por IMEI?

En Movical.Net te informamos si tu equipo se puede desbloquear por IMEI, simplemente selecciona el
modelo y operador original que bloquea el equipo, y te informamos si se puede liberar la red para
usar con otros operadores.


### ¿Cuánto tarda el desbloqueo del teléfono por IMEI?

Esto depende mucho del modelo y operador original que bloquea el celular. Al seleccionar el modelo
en nuestra web, te informamos del precio y tiempo de entrega. Muchos desbloqueos son instantáneos y
otros pueden tardar algunos días.


### ¿Con qué operadores de Estados Unidos puedo liberar mi celular?

Puedes desbloquear un equipo de cualquier operador (Spectrum, AT&T, US Cellular, Cricket, Sprint,
T-Mobile, Verizon, MetroPCS, Tracfone, Boost Mobile, StraightTalk, Simple Mobile, Family Mobile,
Xfinity Mobile, Viaero, Total Wireless, Visible Wireless, Consumer Cellular, Dish Mobile, GCI),
simplemente debes contactar por teléfono con a Atención al cliente, el desbloqueo es gratis siempre
y cuando se cumplan los requisitos que exige la operadora. Si no fuese así, Movical.Net puede
ayudarte a conseguir el desbloqueo por código o por autorización de desbloqueo a través del número
IMEI.

### ¿Cómo liberar un celular por IMEI?

A través del IMEI se puede desbloquear un teléfono de forma remota sin moverse de casa, sin tener
que llevarlo a ninguna tienda físicamente. El proceso se realiza marcando un código de desbloqueo
SIM o por autorización de desbloqueo en el cual el equipo se conecta a internet y se desbloquea
automáticamente.

Simplemente seleccione el modelo en nuestra web y el operador original que bloquea el teléfono. La
web le mostrará las opciones de desbloqueo para poder utilizar su equipo con cualquier operador del
mundo.


### ¿Qué es significa liberar la red un teléfono?

Liberación o desbloqueo de la red es el proceso para que un celular pueda utilizar cualquier tarjeta
SIM o eSIM, es decir, se pueda usar cualquier compañía del mundo.


### ¿Cuánto cuesta un desbloquear un teléfono por IMEI?

En Movical.Net te informamos si tu equipo se puede desbloquear por IMEI, simplemente selecciona el
modelo y operador original que bloquea el equipo, y te informamos si se puede liberar la red para
usar con otros operadores.


### ¿Cuánto tarda el desbloqueo del teléfono por IMEI?

Esto depende mucho del modelo y operador original que bloquea el celular. Al seleccionar el modelo
en nuestra web, te informamos del precio y tiempo de entrega. Muchos desbloqueos son instantáneos y
otros pueden tardar algunos días.


### ¿Con qué operadores de Estados Unidos puedo liberar mi celular?

Puedes desbloquear un equipo de cualquier operador (Spectrum, AT&T, US Cellular, Cricket, Sprint,
T-Mobile, Verizon, MetroPCS, Tracfone, Boost Mobile, StraightTalk, Simple Mobile, Family Mobile,
Xfinity Mobile, Viaero, Total Wireless, Visible Wireless, Consumer Cellular, Dish Mobile, GCI),
simplemente debes contactar por teléfono con a Atención al cliente, el desbloqueo es gratis siempre
y cuando se cumplan los requisitos que exige la operadora. Si no fuese así, Movical.Net puede
ayudarte a conseguir el desbloqueo por código o por autorización de desbloqueo a través del número
IMEI.
